_comment: Columns of Account_Research.xlsx in order, and the allowed values of the closed fields. Read by scripts/common.py. Builder-owned: the agent never edits this file.
columns: Best Person to Reach Out (HumanCloud side)
_comment_reason_fields: A reason field is never left empty: it holds a cited fact or 'Not found (checked: <sources tried>)' (India Connection: 'No evidence found (checked: ...)').
_comment_derived: derived_columns are appended after columns on every Accounts sheet by excel_upsert.py (scripts/evidence.py); key_fields set Freshness and Key Field Confidence.
_comment_typed: typed_columns follow derived_columns: one fact per cell, set by scripts/typed.py only from cited facts (ints, ISO dates, enums), each with an Evidence row; blank when uncited.
_comment_h1b: h1b_columns follow typed_columns: DOL OFLC LCA disclosure data for the last 4 quarters (scripts/h1b.py), cited per quarter file in Evidence; a company-level hiring signal, never a claim about a person.
